rows.note: Use this for an amount, level, or quality that falls short; it is the usual spoken choice for insufficiency.

example.english: The lighting in this room is deficient, so it’s hard to work at night.
example.traditional: 呢間房嘅光線唔夠，夜晚做嘢好辛苦。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 fong4 ge3 gwong1 sin3 m4 gau3 je6 maan5 zou6 je5 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when an essential ability, resource, or quality is lacking rather than merely below the required amount.

example.english: This plan is deficient in clear direction.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃缺乏清晰嘅方向。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 kyut3 fat6 cing1 sik1 ge3 fong1 hoeng3
